thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in CUDA OOMs on cluster gpu-pool-3 (service: inference-runtime/paged-allocator). 18 nodes reporting OOMs in last 5m, container restarts increasing. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.ai/ABCD-1234 :warning:

sara: taking this oncall, i'm online. starting triage.

mike: noticed 502 spikes for hosted-api /v1/generate; customer impact ~4% errors over baseline. logs show repeated allocation failures before container SIGKILL.

raj: initial theory = KV cache fragmentation + paged-attn slab drift -> slow memory creep until CUDA OOM. saw similar pattern last month.

lucy: pushing recent heap / kv stats from node g3-14: ```
[kv] total_pages=3.2G used=2.9G fragmented=420M free_slabs=80M
[paged-alloc] active_chunks=128k avg_chunk_sz=24k
[cuda] free_mem=120MB -> 8MB on OOM
Trace: gpu_alloc_try -> page_map_grow -> oom -> crash
```

raj: mitigation checklist: 1) enable aggressive KV compaction on affected nodes 2) reduce per-request KV warmup 3) roll out short-term autoscale of gpu-pool-3 + soft-fallback to smaller model variant 4) drain highest-oom nodes and force container restart sequence.

sara: doing 1 & 4 now. running compaction job on g3-14 and g3-18. cmd: ```curl -XPOST "https://ops.internal/api/v1/nodes/g3-14/actions/kv-compact" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN'```

ops-bot: job queued: kv-compact on g3-14 (job id jc-9921). estimate ~45s per node.

mike: starting a canary scale up: +3 nodes in gpu-pool-3 to soak traffic. also enabling fallback route policy for hosted-api to route new requests to model:xsmall-1 when latency > 250ms.

nora: customers impacted primarily long-context workloads (>8k). external ops report increased latency and occasional 504s. CS paged this morning at 22:12 UTC.

lucy: compaction on g3-14 finished. fragmentation dropped ~200MB. running a targeted restart of inference-runtime container now: ```kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime --selector=node=g3-14 --grace-period=30```

incident-bot: NOTE: restart completed on g3-14. container restarted x3 on g3-18 in last 12m.

raj: while compaction buys time, long-term fix: adjust paged-allocator refcount scavenge thresholds and add periodic background defrag. will open RFC.

sara: after restarts + compaction, OOM rate dropped from 18 -> 6 nodes. error rate on hosted-api down to +1.2% over baseline. continuing night watch.

mike: i've left the autoscale + fallback in place. creating a temporary rollout policy to prefer dedicated nodes for large-context customers.

nora: tagging impacted customers and notifying CS with ETA ~2h for full stabilization. recommending customers reduce max_seq_len where possible.

lucy: pushed a hotfix env toggle to inference-runtime: KV_PAGE_COMPACT_INTERVAL=30s and KV_EVICT_AGGRESSIVE=true for gpu-pool-3. monitoring.

ops-bot: drain sequence started on g3-18, 1 node removed from LB.

raj: note: keep an eye for node-flap cascade when multiple nodes hit compaction simultaneously. stagger compactions by 20s.

sara: handing off to mike for overnight watch. summary: root cause suspected kv/paged allocator fragmentation -> slow memory creep -> CUDA OOM -> container restarts. mitigations applied: compaction, targeted restarts, autoscale + fallback, env toggles. followups: RFC for allocator scavenger + rollout of defrag job.

mike: oncall ack, will monitor metrics and escalate if OOMs rise above 10 nodes. ping me @mike if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

nora: adding this to incident report draft and flagging impacted accounts for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=stabilizing, severity=sev2, owner=mike, incident_id=INC-2026-7845
